definitions.ask: Should each root on the new roots line show how many Today tasks it holds?
definitions.why: The balance between roots is the line's most useful fact, for one faint digit.

choices.label: Faint tabular count after each label (○ bob 5), like the Day strip legend
Bare labels (○ bob) like the ★ type line; counts move to the tooltip

definitions.ask: Which colour should each root's ring wear?
definitions.why: Labels already identify roots; a stable identity colour beats one that shifts all day.

choices.label: Stable area hue, like the ledger home chips; same-area roots share a colour
The Day strip's distinct bar colour when worked today; may change mid-day
